coordinate_contract.actor_origin: ground centre; actor transform is authoritative world position
coordinate_contract.world_space: res://scripts/presentation/world_space.gd; do not add a second conversion
coordinate_contract.facing: set actor.rotation.y = WorldSpace.facing_yaw(facing_deg); do not bake a 180 degree correction

retired_candidate: enemy_heavy: original WIP has no matching game enemy kind; replaced by hooded enemy_sneak
typed_ammo: pistol/rifle/smg/mg/scout ammo -> ammo_pack visual; retain logical item ID
asset_semantics: visual_only; never collision, navigation, combat LOS, damage or live replay state

rig.rest_pose: same named bone hierarchy, rest matrices and inverse binds for all seven characters and all three LODs
rig.weights: Normalized, at most four GLB influences. Continuous jacket spine/chest; upper/lower sleeves and trousers blend around elbows/knees; shoulder, wrist and boot shaft blend across adjoining named bones. Static accessory and glove finger forms, no finger rig.
rig.scale: 1,1,1; unit is metres; no root motion

weapon_socket: actual GLB nodes <asset_id>__socket_grip / <asset_id>__socket_muzzle / <asset_id>__socket_support_hand, authored and validated in exported +Y up/-Z forward axes. Pistol has no support marker. Socket points are model local: transform by attached gun.global_transform.
grip_contract: For new firearm clips use per-model pose_support. Existing support_hand at (0,0,-.26) remains for legacy rifle holds; pistols retain legacy support_hand=null. All models add pose_support, sight and reload_contact nodes. Hand.R/hand.L mount offset and X+90deg unchanged.
animation_loop: glTF has no looping field; use catalog_candidate.json after integration review

animation_actions.walk: in-place rifle locomotion; actor world travel comes only from historical/presentation state
animation_actions.fire: single rifle recoil, return to aim
animation_actions.pickup: Deep crouch, right palm at grenade ground grip at midclip; presentation controls pickup/stow events
animation_actions.deploy: Deep crouch, right palm at mine ground grip at midclip; presentation controls placement/release events
animation_actions.death: fall, tuck arms, hold terminal prone pose; detach/hide weapon independently
animation_actions.haul: In-place two-hand ammo-pack carry at front waist, 0.12m separation; corpse drag not accepted

sneak_pose: sneak identity uses enemy_sneak, crouch/crouch_walk when historical state requests crouch. Asset does not invent historical state.

material.orm: actor_atlas_orm.png linear; R=AO constant1, G=roughness, B=metallic; metallic scalar1
material.sharing: one StandardMaterial3D reused across all actors, guns and tools; textures remain external and are not duplicated in GLBs
material.loader_patch: separate material-routing.candidate.patch for integrator review; do not apply yard atlas to v2_actor_atlas

lod.selection: explicit fixture LOD selection verified; runtime screen size/distance thresholds and hysteresis belong to integrator. No automatic LOD claim.
lod.generation: Each LOD constructed at fixed tessellation/feature tier. No Decimate. 51/51 raw and semantic hashes equal in independent Blender 4.3.2 runs.

remaining_acceptance: Main PR15 author: review candidate catalogs/material routing, choose clips from historical weapon ID, connect gameplay/replay equipment events without live-state leakage.
Main PR15 author: locomotion upper-body masks, arbitrary midclip cancellation, rapid repeated shots, weapon swaps, LOD transitions, full six-level replay/pause/2x behavior.
Dot asset stream: knife lunge, grenade throw, dedicated decoy placement, corpse haul and improved death/contact candidates; existing haul remains ammo carry.
Dot asset stream plus parent art review: historically accurate ten-gun geometry/mechanisms, static-glove limitations, procedural near faces/clothing and final tactical style quality.
Main author plus parent: actual six-level dusk occlusion, silhouettes, identity/muzzle readability and scene rendering/animation memory budgets.
Device validation owner after production/integration: mobile FPS/memory/compression/thermals/touch; postponed by user.
External GPT PLAN/REVIEW unavailable; no artistic or full battle approval.
catalog: ArtSource/v2/actor_acceptance/catalog_candidate.json is review data, not auto-applied runtime manifest
tool_socket: All five tools have actual named GLB grip markers. Mine grip R3 local [.115,.075,0]; use marker-derived offset, not old hard-coded 35mm height. Mine pressure plate remains [0,.075,0]. Fit checks are independent samples; runtime placement/release events remain integrator scope.

interface_changes_r3.preserved: 20 named bones/rest/inverse binds, 12 names/durations, all other weapon/tool markers, hand mounts, IDs and material slot
interface_changes_r3.low_ready: Weapon barrel follows common hand bone direction; do not hard-code a world forward basis for low-ready.

firearm_profiles: Optional firearm_profiles_candidate.json: 10 actual IDs x 3 roles, six pose groups (Thompson vertical foregrip variant), 40 added clips. Existing 12 actions, 20 rest bones and all original sockets unchanged.
animation_catalog: All seven characters and all three LODs expose 52 animations: legacy12 plus six groups x ready/aim/fire/raise/lower and ten reload_contact_<weapon_id>.
runtime_timing_candidate: firearm_runtime_contract_candidate.json mirrors actual ten-gun timing read-only; no independent simulation reload state exists in the baseline. Main author owns historical event selection, rapid-fire scaling, masking and interruption.
